school_count_interpretation: At least five distinct observed school identifiers prove the minimum. Additional unknown school identifiers remain a quality note and do not invalidate that lower bound. Peer/unit-specific estimators still require their own observed unit identifier.
apply_to: Every displayed estimate and every component of a displayed contrast, in every required plausible value; use focal peer targets rather than the full peer frame.
treatment: Retain the approved task, its estimate, certificate and provenance. Mark insufficient support as a separate product-quality restriction; do not plot it, use it in a reference mean or rank, replace it by zero, shorten the anchor, or relabel it as a missing questionnaire.

source.title: OECD PISA 2022 Results Volume I, Reader's Guide: data underlying the figures
source.finding: OECD denotes estimates based on fewer than 30 students or fewer than five schools with valid data as insufficiently reliable to report.

iea_application: The same minimum is an explicit conservative project reporting condition for IEA results, not a claim that IEA officially uses this cutoff. IEA nonresponse, design and population qualifications remain separate.
scope_effect: No new statistic, no deleted target and no additional pupil-level estimation. A valid zero with sufficient analysis support remains a displayed result.
limitations: Passing this minimum does not establish representativeness, measurement invariance, normality or adequate precision. Existing design/PV uncertainty and official sample qualifications still apply.
